class.value: Captain / Fury / Guardian / Prizefighter / Bounty Hunter

requirement.value: Captain (Commander), Fury, Guardian, Prizefighter (Weaponmaster) or Bounty Hunter mastery + Bone Crusher (the Pilot route is cut)

system.description: When Bone Crusher targets only one creature and you have a shield equipped, challenge that creature until the end of your next turn: it must include you among the targets of its attacks and offensive spells, if able. Once per turn — including other creatures' turns — you deal 5 extra damage to it with a free attack using a one-handed melee weapon, or a custom dagger or sword. The challenge ends if someone else challenges it, or if you challenge another.
